title: Knowledge graph L2-DMN: DMN Decision
description: A `dmn:decision` -- the question being answered, and the node that carries the link back to the BPMN task invoking it. A file may hold several; the BCG file holds one. Class IRI: http://smart.who.int/kg/dmn-decision.

resourceType.description: Resource type identifier for KGDmnDecision logical model

id.description: The identifier the source declares (an FSH instance id, a BPMN or DMN element id).

question.description: The decision's question, as the DMN states it.

allowedAnswers.description: The decision's allowed answers, as the DMN states them.
